name: Heralath Fallowbrook
summary: Deep in Razorfen Kraul, Heralath Fallowbrook lies dying in quilboar hands. Sent to investigate the briars around Ancient Agamaggan's remains, he was captured and brutalized. Now he hopes word of his fate and his cherished pendant will reach his wife in Darnassus.

sections.title: A Tragic Mission
sections.body: Heralath Fallowbrook came to the southern Barrens to investigate Ancient Agamaggan and the briars spreading around his remains. Sent by his people, the night elf druid sought the source of Razorfen Kraul's corruption. The quilboar captured him instead and locked him in a pen, where beatings and fever left him with mortal wounds. Before he faded, Heralath told Henrig Lonebrow, a dwarf captive, what he had learned. He urged Henrig to warn the sentinel outpost at Thalanaar about the aggression stirred by Charlga Razorflank, the quilboar crone.

sections.title: A Dying Wish
sections.body: Heralath Fallowbrook is too weak to flee Razorfen Kraul, even after Henrig Lonebrow escapes. Near death in the tangled pens, the druid holds on long enough to speak to travelers. He asks them to recover his wife Treshala's pendant from his captors and carry it to her in Darnassus. The pendant will bring Treshala word of his fate, and show that Heralath remembered her to the end.

faq.answer: Heralath Fallowbrook is a night elf druid held captive in Razorfen Kraul. He came to the Barrens to study the corruption of the brambles and the legacy of Ancient Agamaggan, the fallen boar, but the quilboar captured and fatally tortured him.

faq.q: What happened to Heralath inside Razorfen Kraul?
faq.answer: The Razorfen quilboar captured Heralath, beat him, and locked him in a hut. Abuse and illness left him near death by the time rescuers could reach him.

faq.q: What does Heralath ask travelers to do?
faq.answer: Heralath asks travelers to recover his wife's pendant from the quilboar and carry it to her in Darnassus, along with word of his fate.

faq.q: Who was Henrig Lonebrow to Heralath?
faq.answer: Henrig Lonebrow was a dwarf captive held in the same pen as Heralath. Before Henrig escaped, Heralath told him what he knew about Agamaggan and urged him to warn the Thalanaar outpost about Charlga Razorflank's movements.

angles.text: As a druid, seeing Heralath broken by Razorfen Kraul's brambles shows how unchecked corruption spreads through the southern Barrens.
As a night elf, carrying Heralath's pendant to Darnassus honors a fallen brother who gave his life trying to understand and heal Kalimdor's wounded lands.
